payoutAccount.title: Payout account

panel.noDefault: No default rule yet. Create a rule and set it as the store default.

panel.deleteDescriptionFallback: This rule will be permanently removed.

form.description: Define how each tip splits. Percentages must total 100%; the first recipient absorbs rounding remainders.

form.impactNone: Nothing is pending under this rule, so only future tips are affected.
form.storeStays: {pct}% stays with the business house account.

toast.createdDescription: It can be set as the store default or assigned to QR codes.
toast.updatedDescription: Future tips will use the new split.
